description: Test vectors for the per-request TLP admission rule (ADR-0033 decision 11, ADR-0038 decision 5), generated by tests/models/test_tlp_admit_vectors.py from homelabnext.registry.model_tlp.admit over the role table in `roles`. header null = the request carried no X-HNX-TLP field. Each vector's last six fields are Admission.record(): role (mdl:<name>), allowed, reason, label (the label judged), ceiling (the role's) and leaves_lab (chain-inclusive). Labels least to most restrictive: clear, green, amber, amber+strict, red.
